meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

howto.when: 当数据超出内存、需要把 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到更大数据集或集群,或要并行处理多个 CSV/Parquet 文件时使用。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses Dask to run pandas/NumPy workflows on larger-than-RAM data, splitting work into parallel tasks on cores or a cluster. Operations stay lazy until .compute() is called.
howto.when_en: Use when data exceeds available RAM, when scaling pandas/NumPy code to larger datasets or clusters, or when processing many CSV/Parquet files in parallel.
